proposed_comments.body:
### Resolve the failing x64 Release CI job

**Severity:** `high`

The x64 Release CI job currently fails in the generated-icon tests because they require a font outline even though the feature intentionally falls back to a background tile when usable font coverage is unavailable. Make the assertions portable across CI images while continuing to verify the background, cache identity, and any outline that can be produced.

review.body: Please address the failing x64 Release CI job before this is merged.
